title: Medibank Live Better Points Being Devalued
body:
New apple watches just dropped in the live better store and I was expecting lower points required as the series 12 and the Ultra 4 dropped in price compared to the previous generation(on apple store).
I had my eye on the ultra 4, and was expecting it to cost 134900 points for the base model which costs $1349.00 but it's listed as 155250 points. The previous watch ultra 3 cost $1499 and required 149900 points. This is quite a steep devaluation of points and we were given no warning.
Some Apple products like the Airpods pro3 are still unaffected. That's still 43000 points for a $430 price on apple store.
My brother says more points required for the iconic gift card too now, so I think they are secretly devaluing the points.
